name: Kousoku Inran Jugyou Maid-tachi no Shigoto
original_name: 拘束 淫爛授業 メイドたちの仕事
source:
A relative of Mayu notices changes in her behavior and sends family maid Kana as a transfer student to the same class to watch after Mayu. The school kingpins aim to make Kana a slave, but since they lack any compromising materials, they plan to use obedient Mayu to break the will of Kana.  

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
真由的亲戚注意到她行为上的变化，于是让家里的女仆加奈以转学生身份进入同一个班级，照看真由。学校里的恶霸们企图把加奈变成奴隶，但手里没有任何能威胁她的材料，于是打算利用顺从的真由来摧毁加奈的意志。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
